verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's GitHub Actions integration lets it act as an on-demand cloud-triggered assistant for PR reviews, issue triage, and @gemini-cli mentions to debug or delegate tasks, and it can run non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation — some cloud/CI presence exists. However there's no evidence of a dedicated cloud-hosted agent autonomously building, testing, AND producing a demo of a full feature end-to-end for review; the GitHub integration is reactive/task-scoped rather than an end-to-end build-test-demo pipeline. Missing for 10: evidence of full autonomous cloud build+test+demo workflow, demo artifact generation, and independent confirmation of successful end-to-end feature delivery via the cloud integration.
